14                 ACTING PRESIDENT BAILEY:   Senator 

15    Martins to explain his vote.

16                 SENATOR MARTINS:   Thank you, 

17    Mr. President.

18                 I want to thank the sponsor for 

19    proposing this bill.  It's an important bill.  

20    When our not-for-profits -- in this case, a 

21    school district -- is forced to pay property 

22    taxes, they have to take resources away from 

23    other things in order to make that payment.

24                 The opportunity they have to get 

25    paid back for literally tens of thousands of 


                                                                754

 1    dollars in tax payments that they should never 

 2    have made to begin with is an important part of 

 3    what we do here in our representing our local 

 4    school districts and suburban communities.  

 5                 So I do want to thank the sponsor 

 6    for doing this.  This particular school district 

 7    and this property happens to be in my district, 

 8    and so it's particularly important that -- to me, 

 9    that this was passed.  And so I want to thank 

10    Senator Thomas not only for carrying it, but 

11    making sure it carried.  And I want to thank all 

12    my colleagues as well.  

13                 Mr. President, I vote aye.

15    Martins to be recorded in the affirmative.
